context.name: Nora
context.text: Are you going to the career fair tomorrow?

explanation: Pregunta indirecta («Do you know where…») con orden de afirmación («where it's being held»), no «where is it». «Be held» = celebrarse (pasiva).

context.name: Yuki
context.text: I think I lost my student ID card somewhere on campus.

explanation: Modal de consejo «should» + infinitivo sin «to» («should report»). «Report something to someone»: el objeto va antes del complemento con «to».

context.name: Paula
context.text: How was your trip to the coast?

explanation: Superlativo de adjetivo largo («the most relaxing») + relativo sin pronombre con present perfect («the … weekend I've had in months»).

context.name: Derek
context.text: Why is the office parking lot so empty today?

explanation: «Most of + grupo» como sujeto. «Decide» va seguido de infinitivo con «to» («decided to work»), no de gerundio.

context.name: Lucia
context.text: Is the résumé-writing workshop worth attending?

explanation: Relativo de sujeto con «that» («the one that helped me») + estructura «help someone do something» (infinitivo sin «to»: «helped me get»).

context.name: Fatima
context.text: I'm trying to find a quiet place to study this afternoon.

explanation: Present perfect interrogativo + pregunta indirecta con «whether»: orden sujeto + verbo («whether the reading room is open»). «If is» rompe ese orden.

context.name: Irene
context.text: The printer in the computer lab is broken again.

explanation: Pregunta indirecta tras «I wonder» (sin inversión: «how long it will take») + estructura «it takes someone time to do something».

context.name: Teresa
context.text: Did you hear back about the scholarship?

explanation: Doble pasiva en estilo indirecto: «I was told that…» (me dijeron) y «decisions would be made». Tras un verbo introductor en pasado, «will» pasa a «would».

context.name: Oscar
context.text: Why didn't you take the earlier train?

explanation: Tercer condicional: «If + past perfect (had left), … would have + participio (would have caught)». «Will have» no expresa hipótesis sobre el pasado.

context.name: Mei
context.text: What did your advisor say about your thesis draft?

explanation: Pregunta indirecta en estilo indirecto: «asked me what sources I had been relying on» (orden sujeto + verbo, sin «did»). El past perfect continuo retrocede el tiempo; «rely on» mantiene la preposición al final.

context.name: Eva
context.text: This bus is so crowded. I can barely move.

explanation: Pregunta indirecta: tras «Do you know when…» va sujeto + verbo conjugado («the next one arrives»), sin auxiliar «does».

context.name: Jamal
context.text: I can't open the shared project folder.

explanation: «Need + to + infinitivo» y el verbo preposicional «ask someone for something» (pedir algo a alguien).

context.name: Priscilla
context.text: Is the new gym better than the old one?

explanation: Comparativo de adjetivo corto («newer», no «more new») intensificado con «much». «What we had» es una cláusula nominal tras «than».

context.name: Linh
context.text: Have you finished the group presentation?

explanation: «Need + to + infinitivo» («need to add»); «the slides about the survey results» es un sintagma nominal con complemento preposicional.

context.name: Ruth
context.text: Why is the café in the student center closed?

explanation: Pasiva en presente continuo («It's being renovated»): el café recibe la acción. Después, futuro negativo con «until» («won't reopen until next month»).

context.name: Adam
context.text: Who's going to run the team meetings next month?

explanation: Pregunta indirecta en la que «who» es el sujeto, así que el orden coincide con el de la pregunta directa: «who will be in charge of them». «Be in charge of» = estar a cargo de.

context.name: Bianca
context.text: This new scheduling software is really confusing.

explanation: Present perfect interrogativo + relativo de objeto con «that» (cosa, no persona: por eso no «who»). «Send out» = enviar a mucha gente (phrasal verb).

context.name: Walter
context.text: What happened at the town hall meeting last night?

explanation: Pregunta indirecta («wanted to know why…») sin inversión + pasiva en past perfect («had been closed»), anterior al momento de la reunión.

context.name: Ines
context.text: Are you still applying to the summer research program?

explanation: Tercer condicional con la oración principal delante: «would have applied if + past perfect (hadn't already passed)». «Didn't» exigiría la forma base «pass».

context.name: Dr. Patel
context.text: Do we know why the experiment failed yesterday?

explanation: «Figure out» (averiguar) + pregunta indirecta en past perfect: «why the samples had overheated», con orden sujeto + verbo y sin «did».
